title: brand.json V2
description: Brand contract written by the project-context agent to <project>/project-context/brand.json and read by every visual agent (carousel-builder, static-ads-builder, landing-page-analyzer captures, future video agents). Every path is relative to the project-context/ folder. A file without schema_version is a V1 file: readers map it with the table in shared/schemas/README.md. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py shared/schemas/brand.schema.json <brand.json>

schema_version.description: Contract version. Absent in V1 files.

name.description: Brand name with its exact casing, as the brand writes it (copy and lint rules reuse it).

source_url.description: Page the tokens were read from.

as_of.description: Date the tokens were extracted or last validated by the founder.

mode.description: Whether colors.bg is a dark or a light background. Visual agents pick the matching logo variant: dark mode uses logos.on_dark.

colors.description: Color roles. Only bg, text and accent are required; readers derive the others with the fallbacks in shared/schemas/README.md.

surface.description: Card, panel or tile background sitting on bg.

text_secondary.description: Body copy and subheads, a step quieter than text.

accent.description: Main brand color, usually the primary CTA background.

accent_secondary.description: Second brand color (gradient stop, secondary button).

on_accent.description: Text color placed on accent (button label).

radius.description: Corner radius of cards and buttons as a CSS length, for example 14px. 0 for square brands.

fonts_url.description: Stylesheet URL that loads the families (Google Fonts css2 URL or the brand's own). Optional when every family ships local files.

logos.description: Logo files by background variant. on_light holds the files that read on a light background (dark ink), on_dark the files that read on a dark background (light ink). Each variant holds a wordmark, a mark (symbol only), or both.

logo_text.description: Wordmark text to typeset when no logo file is usable.

logo_audit.description: Result of the logo checks run by project-context: viewBox against the inked area, and pixel contrast of each file on the background it is meant for.

status.description: unchecked for files migrated from V1 or added by hand.

method.description: render: measured on a rendered image; manual: the founder looked at the brand board.

viewbox_clips_ink.description: true when part of the glyphs falls outside the declared viewBox.

contrast_ratio.description: WCAG contrast between the logo ink and the variant background.

issues.description: Plain-language problems the founder should know about.

assets.description: Real material harvested from the brand's site. Creative agents reuse these files and never re-scrape.

warnings.description: Extraction caveats kept for the founder (for example a font that needs network access to load).

extensions.description: Free space for agent- or project-specific keys. Readers ignore what they do not know.

color.description: Hex color, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. Flatten rgba() against bg before writing.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the project-context/ folder, for example assets/logos/wordmark-on-dark.svg. Never absolute, never starting with project-context/, never climbing with '..'.

family.description: One family name, unquoted, for example Instrument Serif. The fallback stack goes in fallback.

fallback.description: CSS fallback stack appended after the family, for example Georgia, serif.

files.description: Optional local font files, for offline rendering.

width.description: Pixel width, or viewBox width for SVG.

height.description: Pixel height, or viewBox height for SVG.

ink.description: Dominant color of the logo itself.
